description: The agent AUTHORS the plan for the compositional program (the remaining gain ABOVE the now-at-parity generative leaf), deriving each piece's FORM from the LAW that governs it -- no teacher. A Piece --governed_by--> Principle; prescribe copies the principle's prescribed_action onto the piece and computes its expected_gain = the principle's measured payoff x the piece's applicability, and flags a piece still in a form its evidence REJECTS (current_form == the principle's failed_form). The decisions are Rules over the agent's own laws.

microtheory.name: compositional_plan
microtheory.description: derive the compositional-program plan from the agent's own laws
